title: Senior Data Analyst (f/m/x)
description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth, not comfort. 

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. 

We build high-performing consumer products across multiple brands in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming. You will be part of a company on a path of hyper-growth, spearheading one of the largest innovations in the mobile gaming industry, rewarded user acquisition. 

At exmox, data is the compass that guides product, commercial, and financial decisions. We are moving away from siloed analyst roles and building interdisciplinary data teams where AI, specifically Claude, handles the heavy lifting of routine analysis, freeing analysts to focus on judgment, framing, and impact. 

As a Senior Data Analyst (f/m/x), you will operate as a generalist across product, commercial, and financial questions, using Claude and Databricks daily rather than as an occasional tool, and you will grow alongside the team as it evolves toward deeper data engineering and ML capability. 

What You'll Own: 

- Partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Support, Fraud, and LiveOps teams to bring clarity to ambiguous problems and support decisions with evidence.

- Turn vague business questions, product or commercial, into structured hypotheses, experiments, and decision-ready analyses.

- Use Claude and Databricks as core tools for analysis and automation, not just for dashboarding, including working with high frequency data updating every few minutes rather than static daily aggregates.

- Track and analyze performance across product, campaign, revenue, and profitability dimensions, adapting focus to wherever decision support is most needed.

- Build dashboards and self-service tools that let teams monitor performance without repeated ad hoc requests.

- Identify gaps in tracking and data quality early, and help improve instrumentation across domains.

- Absorb new business context quickly when redeployed to a different stakeholder team, contributing decision-ready work within weeks.

- Share your thinking openly, from quick prototypes to final recommendations, to help the team learn faster.

What Success Looks Like: 

- Product, commercial, and financial decisions are driven by evidence: Your work directly shapes prioritization, budget allocation, and go/no go calls across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Finance.

- Risks and opportunities are identified early: Margin erosion, engagement drops, and high-LTV pockets are surfaced before they become obvious.

- You operate across domains without losing time: When moving from one business question to another, you ramp quickly and start contributing within weeks, not months.

- You drive the shift toward AI-heavy analytics: You use Claude to move faster and push the team's tooling forward rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.

What You Bring

- Experienced: 5+ years of experience in product, business, or behavioral analytics, ideally spanning more than one domain (product, marketing, finance, or commercial operations); B2C, mobile gaming, or AdTech experience is a plus.

- AI Fluency: Genuine hands-on experience working with AI tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow, not just occasional use.

- Technical Expertise: Strong Databricks and/or Spark experience with several years of real, hands on exposure; strong SQL and Python skills for analysis, automation, and modeling; BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar) for dashboarding.

- Analytical and Performance-Driven Mindset: Comfortable framing ambiguous questions into structured hypotheses and evaluating experiments (A/B tests, incrementality).

- Communication and Collaboration: Strong communication skills, able to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders through structured, data-driven argumentation.

- Independent and solution-oriented mindset: Comfortable operating in fast-paced, international environments.

How We Win

- Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

- Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.

- See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.

- Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.

- Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany, working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

SAP S/4HANA Fachbereichskoordinator (m/w/d)

Über uns

Wir sehen die Halbleiterindustrie als Raum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir sehen Chancen. Und wir sehen das enorme Potenzial unserer Graphenlösungen, die Branche grundlegend zu verändern. Wir laden dich ein, diesen Wandel mitzugestalten und mit unserem konsequent menschenorientierten Ansatz kluge Köpfe für eine gemeinsame Vision zu vereinen.

Unsere Vision: Zeige allen, dass du grundlegende Veränderungen bewirken kannst. Beweise mit deinem Wissen und deinen Fähigkeiten, dass Dinge auch anders gemacht werden können. Gemeinsam verändern wir die Art und Weise, wie die Welt miteinander verbunden ist.

Über unsere Technologie

Die Halbleiterindustrie benötigt zunehmend leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch. Unsere Technologie bietet dafür eine Lösung: Wir verbinden Chips zu leistungsstarken Computernetzwerken mit hohem Datendurchsatz und geringer Latenz.

Der Schlüssel liegt in den besonderen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen. Sie ermöglichen es uns, elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu verbinden, sodass unzählige Chips nahezu so miteinander interagieren können, als wären sie ein einziger. Unsere Innovation im Bereich der Graphenphotonik hebt Rechenleistung und Energieeffizienz auf ein völlig neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir verbinden Chips zu leistungsstarken und energieeffizienten Netzwerken und überwinden damit bestehende Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie. Wir liefern die Graphenlösung.

Deine Rolle

Die Black Semiconductor GmbH sucht einen SAP S/4HANA Fachbereichskoordinator (m/w/d) , der als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen den Fachbereichen und externen SAP-Beratern agiert und sicherstellt, dass geschäftliche Anforderungen effektiv in geeignete Systemlösungen übersetzt werden.

Du betreust und pflegst unsere SAP S/4HANA Systemlandschaft über die Bereiche Finance, Logistik, Einkauf und Supply Chain hinweg. Dabei treibst du die kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Geschäftsprozessen, die Optimierung des Systems und die erfolgreiche Umsetzung von Änderungen voran.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

We are on a mission to make humans the strongest security layer.

title: Senior Producer
description:
Senior Producer

ScapeWorld Entertainment 

Remote. Our working day runs on CET, wherever you sit. Full time, on a long-term contract. Starting as soon as you can. Where you live while you do is up to you; the location field on this posting only fits one country, so please read this as the real rule and apply from wherever you are.

About us 

We are Scape, a Swedish game studio of about 30 people, fully remote by choice. We are launching Scape on Steam Early Access later this year: a growing platform of multiplayer games where a player's identity carries across all of them. The first game inside Scape is Gravity: a precision climbing game where 100 players share one server, one tower, and one long way down. Our senior team has shipped and run live games at studios including Arrowhead (Helldivers 2), Avalanche Studios, Epic and Ubisoft.

Since we are a small team about to put our first game in front of players, we are looking for the person who holds the plan, the priorities and the team together while we do it. If that sounds like you, we would love to meet.

The role 

Let us start with the studio you would be joining. Around thirty people, fully remote, and a group of strong leads in design, art, engineering, QA, community and commercial who own their crafts and run their own teams. What we do not have is the person who looks across all of them at once, holds the plan they are all working to, and makes the day-to-day calls that keep it moving as one. That is this role. It is the only production seat in the company, and it comes with real authority.

You would work closely with the Creative Director. They own what the game is, set the direction and make the big bets. You own the plan that gets us there and the decisions inside it: scope, sequencing and trade-offs within a milestone are yours to make, and you decide which questions need to reach them and which do not. They should be able to step back and know that things are being handled, because they are.

In practice, it comes down to four things:

You know how a game gets made. You can see what depends on what, where the effort really sits, and whether an estimate is going to hold. When a lead tells you how long something takes, you know how to hear it and what has to land for the work to ship on time.

You own the plan and the priorities. Not just the schedule, but the order of work behind it. When two things compete, you decide, or you get the decision made and tell everyone affected. Open questions have an owner and a date. Nothing sits unanswered because nobody was sure whose call it was.

You plan ahead. Problems get found while they are still cheap, and everything that has to land together lands together: builds, assets, store material, localization, press dates.

You lead the team's delivery. People know the plan is real, feel good about hitting it, and are still standing when it ships. The leads lead their crafts. You lead how it all comes together, and you meet each team where it is: some want you in the weeds with them on estimates and sequencing, others mainly need the picture across teams kept current. You read which is which.

We have a production pipeline that works, and like any pipeline it can always be better. You would inherit it as it is, get to know it and the people who run it, and then improve it where you see the need. Nobody here expects you to arrive with all the answers. We do hope you arrive curious about how we work and comfortable telling us, kindly and clearly, where we could do better.

What you will own 

- Production priorities day to day: the order of work across the studio, the trade-off calls within a milestone, and every open question that is blocking someone. You find who can answer, get it answered or escalated with a clear recommendation attached, and close the loop with the teams waiting on it. If a question is blocking someone, it is yours until it is not

- Keeping design, art, engineering, QA and marketing in step with each other, week by week, so nobody is working against a version of the plan that has moved

- The forward view: every feature in flight, what each one is still waiting on, the handoffs between departments caught early, and risk seen while it is still cheap, named, and carrying a mitigation before it turns into a schedule event

- The team's delivery health: sustainable pace, morale, and delivery on target, treated as one problem rather than a trade-off

- Marketing as a real production dependency, and the alignment dates around release: builds, assets, store material, localization drops, press dates, landing on time and together

- The production plan behind all of it: a milestone schedule with a baseline, a forecast per milestone from velocity against remaining scope, estimates held against actuals, and replanning on a cycle rather than after something breaks

- QA in step with everyone else. Our QA lead owns testing; you make sure QA knows what is coming and when, that testable builds land when the plan says they do, and that the QA window sits in the schedule where it belongs rather than where it ends up

- External production partners: localization, video, 3D, anything we outsource. You own the relationship and the communication in both directions, and you chase. Briefs and context going out, deliveries coming in and landing in the build, and the schedule that keeps them in step with everyone else. Leads should never have to chase a partner themselves. The craft stays with the partner; making it fit is on you

- The production process itself and the tools it runs through. We use Jira, including Jira Plans for planning months out against a baseline, and you own it for the studio. You also support hiring managers through their recruitment processes, so a lead who is hiring can focus on assessing the person rather than running the process

You 

Most people who can do this job have around five years in games production behind them. Take that as a description of who tends to apply, not a bar we hold. If you can show us the things below with less, please apply anyway. We would rather meet you than miss you.

- You know how games get made across disciplines: what waits on what, how long things really take, and where a plan is optimistic before the dates say so

- You have produced across several titles and taken at least one PC title all the way to release, including the closing stretch: feature lock, bug burn, submission, the go decision. Which store matters less than that you have been through a PC launch. Projects that were cancelled along the way still count; we know how the last few years have gone for a lot of good people

- You have owned priorities, not just a schedule. You have made cut-or-keep calls on a shipped title and lived with them, and you can tell us about one you got wrong

- You have worked closely with a founder, studio head or creative director, and you know how to take decisions off their plate without going around them

- You have built and driven a schedule, and you have written down a way of working that other people picked up and used. We would love to see examples, in whatever form they exist

- You have led a team to a target without burning it out, and the people on it would work with you again

- You are proactive by default and you work independently. You do not wait to be asked or chased; given an assignment, you find out what it needs and finish it well without someone checking each step. That is what senior means to us

- Leads tell you how things are really going, because you talk with them directly and they trust you with the real picture

- You are fluent in Jira at the level of owning it for a team, Jira Plans included. It is a tool, not the job, but it is the tool we run the plan through, so we need you good with it

- You work our day, which runs on CET; where you sit while you do is up to you. And you are comfortable working in English, written and spoken

Helpful, not required 

- Steam specifically: Steamworks, builds and depots, the store page, review and submission, and how Early Access behaves through the whole run

- Live operations and a patch cadence

- Working with external production partners before, on either side of the relationship

- Time at a small studio where you were the only producer, or where the producer and product owner were the same person

- A remote-first team

What we offer 

The whole project and the authority that comes with it. Real decisions, not just a schedule to report against. Strong leads beside you rather than under you, and a Creative Director who wants to hand things over and means it. A company small enough that what you do is visible in what we ship, and people who will notice.

We are a self-motivated team, remote by choice and flexible in how we work, and we run on people helping each other rather than watching each other. Everyone here is trusted to own their part and supported when they need a hand, and we would like that to be true for you from your first week.

And we are early. Scape is heading to Steam with everything still ahead of it. Joining now means building something with a real chance of becoming big, and being one of the people it belongs to when it does.

Practical 

- Remote. Our working day runs on CET and this role keeps it.

- Full time, on a long-term contract.

- Start: as soon as you can. Tell us your notice period in the application form and we will work around it.

- Recruitment is ongoing.

title: B2B2C Marketing Manager (Global)
description:
Location : Berlin (hybrid)

Hi, we are AMBOSS, and we are looking for an experienced marketer to drive our growth globally.

About AMBOSS 

AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we’ve grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.

Why can this position be exciting for you? 

Many of our students and clinicians access AMBOSS through an institutional license from their medical school or hospital. In this role, you’ll own the marketing that turns those license holders into active, engaged AMBOSS users and, ultimately, advocates. You’ll sit between our B2B Sales/Regional teams and our consumer marketing teams, with a clear focus on adoption and engagement of institutional customers.

A license only creates value once someone opens AMBOSS, finds the answer they need before an exam or at the bedside, and comes back the next day. You’ll make that first step easy and help it become a habit. Your work shows up in how many students and physicians actually use AMBOSS, in how confident our Sales and Regional teams feel going into renewals, and in how many future doctors make better decisions for their patients. You’ll build initiatives that work globally and still feel local to each campus and hospital. If you enjoy seeing a direct line from a campaign to real usage, this role gives you plenty of room to build.

You will: 

- Own the end-user journey from “license granted” to “actively using AMBOSS,” including onboarding, activation, and ongoing engagement for students and physicians on institutional licenses.

- Build and maintain automated CRM flows for onboarding, feature announcements, and re-engagement, tailored by audience (students vs. physicians) and institution type.

- Support institutional renewals by identifying low-usage accounts and running targeted engagement campaigns, in close coordination with Sales and Account/Regional Managers.

- Create and maintain institution-facing collateral (onboarding kits, flyers, one-pagers, usage summaries) that Sales and Regional teams use to support rollouts and renewals.

- Own and optimize CMS content and landing pages for institutional end users, including license activation and sign-up flows.

- Partner with institutions on local activation, such as campus ambassador programs, webinars, and events.

You bring: 

- 3-4+ years of experience in B2B, B2B2C, SAAS, or edtech marketing,

- Hands-on experience with CRM/marketing automation tools.

- Strong ownership and accountability in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment

- Detail-oriented ownership of content quality across CMS, CRM, and collateral.

- Data-driven decision-making, even with imperfect or limited data sets.

- Proactive in spotting activation/usage gaps and proposing fixes, not just reporting metrics.

- Excellent stakeholder management across global/local and marketing/sales teams.

Benefits: 

AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health, and work-life harmony.

- 🌴 Rest & Time Off (30 paid vacation days, AMBOSS holiday, personal purpose day and more)

- 🥙 Food & Office Comfort (Daily healthy breakfast & lunch by in-house chef in Berlin HQ, AMBOSS daycare, work remotely from other office spaces in Cologne, Sardinia, Cape Town)

- 🏃 Health, Fitness & Mobility (Urban Sports Club – M plan, Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland Ticket…)

Check out the full list of benefits below:

https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de 

We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. That’s why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone—regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity—is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care 🩺

Even if you don’t meet every single point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We’d love to hear from you!

AMBOSS operates across multiple international markets and diverse verticals. If this specific role doesn’t feel like the perfect match, we encourage you to browse our other open positions in Marketing and beyond to find where you can make the biggest impact.

title: Prakitkant M&A Due Diligence (m/f/d)
description:
Über Buena

Buena wird von GV unterstützt und macht Immobilien einfacher: von der Wohnungssuche über den Kauf und die Finanzierung bis zur Verwaltung. Dafür kaufen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und entwickeln sie mit eigener Technologie und besseren Prozessen weiter. Unser Ziel: Immobilieneigentum und Vermögensaufbau für mehr Menschen zugänglich machen.

Über die Rolle

Bevor wir eine Hausverwaltung übernehmen, müssen wir ihr Geschäft verstehen. Wie belastbar sind die Zahlen? Welche Risiken stecken in den Verträgen? Was braucht das Unternehmen, um nach der Übernahme erfolgreich weiterzulaufen?

Als Praktikant:in M&A Due Diligence gehst du diesen Fragen nach. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Deal Lead und unserem Operations- und Deal-Team an laufenden Übernahmen. Dabei begleitest du Transaktionen vom ersten Datenraum über die Bewertung bis zur Entscheidung des Managements und zum Closing.

In unserem dreiköpfigen Team übernimmst du ab Tag eins eigene Workstreams und nimmst an Gesprächen mit den Geschäftsführern der Zielunternehmen teil. Deine Analysen fließen direkt in unsere Kaufentscheidung ein.

Deine Aufgaben

- Financial DD. Du analysierst BWAs, Jahresabschlüsse und Cashflows, prüfst Umsatz und verwaltete Einheiten und dokumentierst Red Flags. Du arbeitest an Kaufpreismodellen und rechnest Szenarien und Earn-out-Strukturen durch.

- Commercial & Operations DD. Du prüfst Objektlisten, Verwaltungsverträge und ERP-/Prozessdaten. Du bewertest Personal- und Kapazitätsbedarf und bereitest Fragen für die Gespräche mit der Geschäftsleitung vor.

- Entscheidungen vorbereiten. Du verdichtest deine Ergebnisse zu klaren Findings und Executive Summaries. Du bereitest Liegenschaftscontrolling und Liquiditätsplanung auf und lieferst Input für die Entscheidungsvorlage und die Anlagen zum Unternehmenskaufvertrag (SPA).

- Den DD-Prozess steuern. Du erstellst und pflegst Information Request Lists, organisierst den Datenraum in DataSite oder Google Drive und hältst fehlende Unterlagen nach. Du dokumentierst offene Fragen, Fortschritt und Ergebnisse in Linear.

- Eigene Workstreams verantworten. Je nach Erfahrung und Transaktion führst du einzelne DD-Workstreams von der ersten Datenanforderung bis zum Findings-Report.

Du passt, wenn du

- Bereits ein Praktikum oder eine Werkstudententätigkeit in M&A, Transaction Services, Corporate Finance, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Wirtschaftsprüfung oder transaktionsnaher Beratung absolviert hast.

- BWL, VWL, Finance, Accounting, (Wirtschafts-)Recht, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder etwas Vergleichbares studierst – ab dem fünften Semester oder im Master.

- GuV, BWA und Bilanz sicher lesen kannst und verstehst, was Umsatz, EBITDA, Working Capital und Verbindlichkeiten über ein Unternehmen aussagen.

- Bewertungsmethoden wie Multiples und DCF kennst und bereits angewendet hast.

- Excel sicher beherrschst: Pivot-Tabellen, XVERWEIS/SVERWEIS und das Aufbereiten und Konsolidieren unstrukturierter Daten.

- Sorgfältig arbeitest, Unstimmigkeiten hinterfragst und offene Punkte eigenständig klärst.

- Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sprichst und schreibst. Gespräche mit Geschäftsführern, Verträge und Finanzunterlagen sind überwiegend deutsch.

- Für mindestens drei, idealerweise sechs Monate Vollzeit verfügbar bist und aus unserem Berliner Büro arbeiten möchtest.

Was du bei uns lernst

- Wie wir als Käufer Unternehmen prüfen, bewerten und übernehmen – bei einer zweistelligen Anzahl an Transaktionen pro Jahr.

- Wie aus Finanzdaten, Verträgen und Management-Gesprächen eine belastbare Kaufentscheidung entsteht.

- Wie Bewertung, Kaufvertrag und spätere Integration zusammenhängen.

Bei guter Zusammenarbeit gibt es eine Perspektive für den Einstieg nach dem Praktikum. 

Deine Benefits

- Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus, wenn du innerhalb von 10–20 Gehminuten zum Büro wohnst oder dorthin ziehst.

- 110 € Lunch-Budget pro Monat und 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss.

- 1.200 € jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget.

- Kostenlose Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest.

Warum jetzt einsteigen

- Verantwortung folgt Ergebnissen. Wer zuverlässig liefert, bekommt bei uns schnell mehr Verantwortung.

- Wir arbeiten eng zusammen. Aus unserem Büro, mit kurzen Wegen zum Deal Lead und zum Management.

- Wir bauen Buena langfristig auf. Jede Übernahme bringt uns unserem Ziel näher: Immobilien einfacher machen und Vermögensaufbau für mehr Menschen ermöglichen.

title: Senior Engineering Project Manager (m/w/d)
description:
The Role: What to expect Idealworks builds industrial automation as a coordinated system — mobile robots, orchestration software, simulation, and increasingly humanoids and physical AI, working together in real production environments rather than as isolated pilots. Since our founding within BMW Group and our integration into Agile Robots SE, we've grown from a Munich-based robotics team into a global player.

As physical AI and humanoid robotics move from research into industrial deployment, our project landscape is expanding: today's programs span classic mobile robot fleets, next-generation humanoid platforms, and the simulation environments used to develop and validate both. We're looking for a Senior Engineering Project Manager to lead this kind of work end to end - technically credible enough to sit with R&D and hardware/software engineering, and organized enough to keep shareholders, partners, and customers aligned as programs move from concept to production. 

Role Responsibilities: What you will do Project & Program Delivery - Manage complex engineering projects across the full lifecycle — from scoping and planning through execution, integration, testing, and handover — spanning both software and hardware workstreams.
- Define and manage project plans, milestones, budgets, and resourcing; monitor schedule, cost, quality, and contractual compliance throughout.
- Identify technical, schedule, and commercial risks early, and drive mitigation and contingency planning across multi-disciplinary teams.
- Plan and coordinate integration and validation phases (e.g., factory and site acceptance testing) across hardware, software, and systems components.

Cross-Functional & Technical Coordination - Act as the connective layer between product management, partner management, solution engineering, software development, hardware development, R&D, innovation management, and operations — ensuring each function's inputs and dependencies are captured and sequenced correctly.
- Work closely with engineering leads on cutting-edge developments in mobile robots, humanoid platforms, simulation tooling, and physical AI to translate technical realities into realistic, defensible project plans.
- Support innovation and R&D initiatives as they mature into deployable projects, helping bridge the gap between exploratory work and production-grade delivery.

Stakeholder & Partner Management 
- Serve as a primary point of contact for a diverse stakeholder landscape, including shareholders, technology and integration partners, and customers, tailoring communication to each audience.
- Prepare and lead steering committee meetings, status reviews, and escalation discussions; ensure decisions are documented and followed through.
- Manage claims, change requests, and contract or scope amendments in coordination with commercial and legal stakeholders.
- Build long-term, trust-based relationships with partners and customers that extend beyond a single project milestone.

Operational Excellence - Track and report on project and portfolio KPIs (schedule adherence, cost/margin, quality, and stakeholder satisfaction) to leadership and shareholders.
- Contribute to continuous improvement of project management methodology, tooling, and best practices across the organization.
- Support resource planning and prioritization across a portfolio of concurrent engineering projects.

Role Requirements: What you need to succeed - At least 5 years of experience in a similar role, or in a technical role such as engineering, software development, product management, program management, project management, or partner management, within the robotics industry or a domain of comparable technical complexity (e.g., autonomous systems, industrial automation, advanced hardware/software integration).
- Demonstrated ability to manage complex, cross-functional engineering projects that combine hardware and software development.
- Strong technical fluency to engage credibly with R&D, software, and hardware engineers on cutting-edge topics in mobile robotics, humanoids, simulation, or physical AI, without needing to be the domain expert yourself.
- A track record of managing external stakeholders e.g. customers, partners, or investors including steering committees, escalations, and commercial discussions.
- Solid grounding in project management fundamentals: planning, budgeting, risk management, and reporting.
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical and business/executive audiences.
- A degree in engineering, computer science, software development, mechatronics, robotics, or a related technical field is a plus.
- Fluency in English required; German is a plus.
- Willingness to travel internationally as project needs require.

Why idealworks - At idealworks, you will find an international working environment and become part of an experienced, open team where mutual trust counts. You will feel at home from the very first second!
- Experience a first-hand start-up feeling and flat hierarchies with varied and responsible tasks that you work on independently.
- Look forward to hybrid working model with 30 vacation days per year and various opportunities to balance your free time, family and job.
- For your commitment to helping us achieve our mission, you will not only be rewarded with appreciation, but also with above-average pay including a bonus scheme and an annual personal development budget.
- We offer exciting corporate benefits, an attractive company pension scheme and regular team events.
- Our modern office is easily accessible by public transport, bike and car and offers numerous catering options for relaxed lunch breaks with your team.
- Driven by our unique corporate culture, the five values "passion for results", "wellbeing", "personal growth", "trust" and "being and acting as one team" determine our daily actions and cooperation.

title: Remote Maintenance Engineer

description:
About the role Gauss Fusion is aiming to build the first commercial scale fusion power plant based on the stellarator concept and is seeking an experienced mechanical engineer to lead on development of the robotic maintenance approach.
The fusion environment within the reactor is very aggressive, and in-vessel components such as the breeder blanket and divertor will need to be replaced on a regular basis as the materials become damaged by the radiation. Due to the environment inside the device, and in order to maintain a high overall availability, the maintenance must be done robotically using automated systems to extract and replace the components and bring the removed ones to a hot cell for separation, waste treatment, and recycling.
Gauss Fusion is looking for an innovative mechanical design engineer with experience in robotics to lead the work defining and developing the maintenance approach for the Gauss stellarator power plant and its key stellarator systems. While the magnetic configuration will be designed to maximise access to the reactor, the complex geometry poses a challenge to fixations and kinematics, and inventive approaches to the problem are required.

Main responsibilities Manage the Gauss Fusion maintenance approach to meet the requirements of a commercial scale fusion power plant design: - Develop workable approaches to achieving high power plant availability, taking account of engineering and physics requirements across the reactor.
- Integrate these remote maintenance requirements into plant layout specifications.
- Define approaches to minimising hot cell inventory through efficient handling of removed components.
- Lead development of the breeder blanket and divertor segmentation and fixations resulting from these approaches.
- Lead development of remote maintenance testing and demonstration systems for the reactor.

Qualification and educational requirements - Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field, master’s or Ph.D. preferred.
- Technical experience: - Minimum of 6 years of experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in large-scale engineering projects.
- Experience in designing complex mechanical systems, preferably in the energy or nuclear industry.
- Familiarity with CAD software and engineering analysis tools.

Competences and preferred skills - Experience developing remote maintenance systems operating in hazardous environments
- Strong background in mechatronics, motion control and mechanical integration. 
- Experience with digital mock-up will be an asset
- Familiarity with maintenance, inspection and intervention systems 
- Familiarity with system engineering processes, requirements management and verification activities. Strong understanding of mechanical design principles and engineering mechanics.
- Proficiency in structural analysis, finite element analysis (FEA), and kinematic analysis.
- Ability to manage multidisciplinary teams and coordinate with other engineering disciplines.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

title: Sr Data Analyst
description:
The Gecko platform is the core engine of our product experience. To maintain competitiveness and user satisfaction, we must move beyond surface-level metrics to understand the deep correlations between engine performance and real-world user behavior. Scope 

The analyst will focus exclusively on Gecko engine telemetry across multiple platforms (Desktop and Android), collaborating with the Performance Team, Data Team, and Product Leadership.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

The Opportunity: 

We are building a new team of Data Product Partners to bridge the gap between business needs and complex data systems, ensuring our data assets are trustworthy, discoverable, impactful and truly solve user problems.

As a Senior Data Product Partner (DPP) , you will be the driving force behind the impact of our data team with the Perk business. You will move fluently between business and data worlds, making critical decisions rooted in both user needs and technical reality. Your goal is to move beyond simply providing solutions to proving demonstrable business impact.

- Role Title: Senior Data Product Partner

- Reporting To: Manager, Data Product Partner

- Core Mandate: Be the primary data consultant, fixer, strategist, and relationship manager for a specific business domain (e.g. Customer Care, Finance, Marketing, Revenue, Spend & Control, Travel)

- We are open to either Regular or Senior profiles 

What You’ll Do: 

Relationship Management and Strategy 

- Develop Business Data Strategy: Collaborate with business leaders to define how data can drive their strategic goals, solve critical challenges, and uncover new opportunities

- Identify and Qualify Value: Proactively identify high-impact use cases and data initiatives that will generate maximum measurable value (e.g., revenue increase, cost reduction, efficiency gain) for the partner business unit

- Act as the primary translator across all disciplines, explaining the same concept differently to different data team roles and executives

- Proactively manage expectations and define the appropriate scope and flexible roadmaps

- Develop Product Sense for Data, anticipating common data quality issues, recognising when simpler solutions are better, and strategically saying "no" to requests that compromise our aligned vision

- Publicise and amplify the work that has been done to drive adoption of and learning from our solutions

- Coach teams to be able to self serve their own preliminary investigations

Demand Shaping and Portfolio Management 

- Focus on defining what to build and why (Data Product Partner) rather than how (AE/ DA/ DE/ DS/ DG). Ensuring that we built the right thing - vs the Data Team Lead owning did we build the thing right

- While the Data teams own the timeline estimates, the DPP defines the urgency, the required business target date and the prioritisation, which then influences how the Craft team approaches the estimate

- Shape and Prioritise Demand: Work with business stakeholders to clarify their data needs, translating vague requests into well-defined, measurable projects and technical data requirements that can be handed over to the Data Teams

- Manage the Business Unit's Data Portfolio: Oversee the pipeline of data projects, data products and initiatives relevant to their business unit, ensuring alignment with capacity and strategic priorities. Work closely with Data teams to evaluate technical tradeoffs with potential business impact

- Conduct Value Realisation Tracking: Continuously monitor and report on the actual business outcomes and ROI delivered by completed data projects and products

Ad-Hoc Analysis, Triage & Intake Management 

- The Data Product Partner is the first line of response for data questions from the business and plays a critical role in determining the right level of effort and ownership

- Conduct initial ad-hoc analysis where appropriate, including lightweight SQL queries, exploratory analysis in Looker as well as quick validations, sanity checks, and hypothesis testing

- Use this initial analysis to answer simple, time-sensitive business questions directly, clarify the underlying problem and assess feasibility, data quality, and potential impact

- Triage and prioritise ad-hoc requests by determining whether the request can be resolved quickly vs. requires deeper analytical or engineering work. Escalate and hand over well-defined requests to Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science or Data Governance when needed. Provide clear context, urgency, and success criteria to downstream teams

- Actively identify recurring ad-hoc requests that indicate a gap in existing dashboards or data products, a need for improved data quality, documentation, or enablement or an opportunity to convert reactive work into scalable data products

description:
Who are we? 

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how enterprises harness the power of AI in real-world applications. As a bridge between our core North product and our clients’ engineering teams, you’ll be at the forefront of solving complex problems and securely integrating AI into critical sectors such as finance, healthcare, and telecommunications.

We’re looking for Software Engineers with Applied AI experience who can own the design, build, and deployment of agentic workflows powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), from early prototypes to production-grade AI agents, to deliver concrete business value in enterprise workflows. 

You’ll work closely with customers on real-world business problems, often building first-of-their-kind agent workflows that integrate LLMs with tools, APIs, and data sources. While our pace is startup-fast, the bar is enterprise-high: agents must be reliable, observable, safe, and auditable from day one.

Location: UK

Active DV clearance is highly preferred 

In this role, you will: 

- Work closely with our enterprise customers to translate high-value, ambiguous business problems into well-framed agentic workflows with clear success criteria and evaluation methodologies

- Lead the design, build, and delivery of LLM-powered agents that reason, plan, and act across tools, APIs, and sensitive enterprise data sources, with enterprise-grade reliability and performance

- Build and ship features for North, our AI workspace platform, working across the full product lifecycle from conceptualisation through production

- Take ownership of scoping and shaping use cases end-to-end, flexing into whatever technical area the problem demands (including frontend) to drive the most effective solution

- Contribute to shared frameworks and patterns that enable consistent, high-quality delivery across customers and teams

- Drive clarity in ambiguous situations, build alignment, and raise engineering quality across the organization

- Travel up to 20–40% to work on-site with customers and partners

You may be a good fit if: 

- You have hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade software in Python; you write clean, testable, observable, scalable code

- You've built and deployed highly performant RAG and agentic applications, including agents that plan and execute multi-step tasks using patterns like ReAct or Plan-and-Execute

- You're deeply familiar with the LLM stack: frontier models, vector databases, and orchestration frameworks

- You have a proven ability to build robust evaluation frameworks, moving well beyond trial and error, to measure agent accuracy, safety, and latency

- You’re experienced working directly with customers and can lead technical discussions with enterprise stakeholders, translating ambiguous business needs into concrete technical specs

- You have experience owning the full scope of a use case end-to-end

- You thrive in fast-paced and ambiguous environments and can execute well even when priorities are shifting

It's a bonus if you have: 

- Experience setting architectural standards for AI and agentic systems across distributed teams

- Experience flexing into unfamiliar technical areas, such as frontend, when the problem calls for it

- Exposure to regulated or sensitive industry environments (finance, healthcare, telecoms)

- Experience with enterprise security, compliance, or auditability requirements for AI systems

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks: 

- A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

- Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

- RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

- 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

- Annual enrichment benefits:

Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

- 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

- Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

- For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

- For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

title: First RevOps
description:
At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. 

Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started.

The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it !

Context 

Our coding agent is live in 70 hospitals across France. In March, we raised $20M from Index Ventures to push it further and build what comes next: billing, admissions, patient records.

The next six months are going to move fast. We'll double to +60 people, open Germany, and triple the size of our Revenue team. Today, too much of how we run the company still depends on manual work and tools that don't talk to each other.

Nobody owns this problem yet, it will be yours.

Your mission 

Make sure Parallel can double without drowning in manual work.

Attio, our CRM, will be your main tool, and you'll run it end to end. You'll also sit with each team, see what they still do by hand, and automate it yourself. On top of that, you'll work on Sales, Marketing and Finance Ops topics, like billing, cash tracking and commissions.

You'll report to Clem, our Ops Lead, and work every day with the founders and the go-to-market teams. You build things, you don't write decks about them. There's no team to manage at first, but the function is yours to shape, and we assume it will grow.

What you'll do

Own Attio, end to end 

- Administer and configure Attio: data model, pipelines, fields, views, access rights and workflows

- Enrich our CRM with data valuable for Sales, Ops and Finance teams, so that it can be the source of truth while scaling

- Connect Attio to the rest of our stack so processes run without manual steps

- Support users and turn their pain points into better configurations

Automate our internal work, with AI where it makes sense 

- Map repetitive tasks across Sales, Marketing, Ops and Finance, and prioritize them by impact and effort

- Build automations, integrations and AI use cases yourself, with no-code or low-code tools, and APIs when needed

- Pick a simple rule or AI depending on the need, test on real cases, and keep a human in the loop when it matters

- Protect sensitive data, control access, and measure time saved, errors and costs

Make Sales and Ops steering reliable 

- Help define the priority metrics and agree on shared definitions

- Run the analyses, SQL queries and dashboards yourself

- Automate data collection and updates to kill manual reporting

Build processes that hold as we double 

- Document the rules, owners, limits of AI use and what to do when something breaks

- Structure the handoffs between teams, train users and check real adoption in the field

Outcomes 

You ship from week one: automations are expected in your first month, not in six.

Month 1: diagnose and ship a first win 

- You run Attio autonomously, have audited its configuration and data, and shipped the first improvements teams feel

- A prioritized list of automation and AI opportunities, and a 90-day plan validated with Clem

- Your first automation is live, tested with its users, with a baseline measured to track the gain

Month 2: deploy and measure 

- Several automations are used by the teams, with time saved and output quality tracked on real cases

- Priority metrics are live and tested with the teams

Month 3: stabilize and drive adoption 

- Several automations run in production, used regularly, with error monitoring and a clear maintenance owner

- Attio and our data are reliable enough for the priority processes, and shared metrics are used to make decisions

- Users are trained, and your 6-month extension plan is validated with Clem

Month 6: scale what works 

- The solutions that work are extended, documented and monitored

- The key handoffs between teams are structured and adopted, keeping pace as we grow to around 60 people and open Germany

You are

The non-negotiable 

- You have run a CRM yourself, not just used it. You have administered, configured and optimized one personally: data model, pipelines, permissions, workflows, integrations. Attio experience is a plus; if you come from another CRM, you can show you will master Attio fast. Strong automation or AI skills won't make up for this one

Also essential 

- 3-5 years of RevOps, SalesOps or BizOps experience in a B2B startup, with business automations you built and shipped yourself

- Real use of AI applied to internal work, and the judgment to know when a simple rule does the job better

- At ease with data: you write SQL, run your own analyses and build dashboards; you ship a working v1 fast, then improve it

- Autonomous and pragmatic: you don't wait for a detailed spec, you go after the high-impact problems and deliver simple, usable solutions

- Rigorous: you check your work, set up controls and document so processes are reproducible

- You explain technical topics simply to business teams, and get them to agree on rules and actually adopt them

Nice to have 

- A solid understanding of how a SaaS business works, from sales cycle to operations to billing

And you share our values 

- Play to Win: you set ambitious, measurable goals and own the result

- High Trust, High Standards: you keep your commitments, raise risks early and hold a high quality bar

- Low Ego, Hands-On: you take feedback, change course when facts say so, and do the unglamorous work yourself

- Win as One Team: you put the collective goal ahead of your own scope

- Don't Take Yourself Too Seriously: you own your mistakes and keep perspective when things get tense

Hiring process

- First call with Wallerand: our values, your background, and a first look at your CRM and automation experience

- Interview with Clem, Ops Lead: your future manager, deep dive into how you build and run a CRM and your automations

- Case study at our Paris office with Paul (CEO) and Clem: you structure and configure a CRM, then automate a process, from framing to a working prototype

- Founder interview with Paul 

- Reference checks , with your consent

- Offer 

Why should you join us?

- AI with real-world impact. Our agents free hospital teams from paperwork, in a system where 70% of French hospitals are in deficit

- A function to build from scratch. You are our first RevOps: the stack, the processes and how we use AI internally are yours to design

- The right moment. A $20M Series A closed in March 2026, the team doubling to around 60 people, Germany opening, and everything still to build

- An AI-native company that practices what it sells. We automate hospitals; you get to automate Parallel

- Top-tier backers and founders. Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, the CEO of Mistral AI; founders from Meta, McKinsey and Hublo

- Direct line to the founders. You work daily with Paul and the founding team, and your work shapes how the company scales

- Room to grow. The role starts hands-on, with the prospect of building a team as the function grows

- Competitive package. A competitive salary and equity (BSPCE), so you share in what you help build

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. 

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

title: Procurement Manager
description:
About Us 

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role 

As Procurement Manager, you will lead procurement, material planning and supply readiness to support our production schedules as we scale. You will own the operating mechanisms that turn demand into executable material plans, including Clear to Build (CTB) analysis, MRP execution and purchase order management. Leading a team of Buyers and Material Planners, you will work closely with Strategic Sourcing, Planning, Engineering, Quality, Finance and our suppliers to remove material constraints before they impact manufacturing.

Responsibilities 

- Manage and develop a team of Buyers and Material Planners, setting priorities and giving them the tools and training to execute.

- Own Clear to Build analysis and translate demand into executable material plans for production.

- Identify material constraints before they impact production, and drive cross functional actions to resolution.

- Improve the quality of MRP inputs, including lead times, safety stocks, order policies, MOQ and planning parameters.

- Hold suppliers accountable for delivery performance, and drive recovery plans when commitments are at risk.

- Represent material readiness in production, S&OP, shortage and operational review meetings.

- Monitor and report key indicators on supplier performance, material availability and supply risks.

- Resolve downstream issues with receiving, finance and accounting teams.

- Maintain procurement master data in the ERP system and build scalable processes as the company grows.

Candidate Requirements 

- Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain or a related discipline.

- Experience: 5+ years of supply chain experience in progressive roles, ideally in a manufacturing environment.

- Proven Leadership: 2+ years managing or leading procurement, planning or materials teams.

- Technical Expertise: Strong practical knowledge of MRP logic, BOM driven material planning, inventory management and production supply.

- Material Readiness: Demonstrated experience developing or operating Clear to Build processes in a manufacturing environment.

- Scaling Experience: Experience supporting NPI, engineering changes and production ramps, and building scalable processes in a rapidly changing environment.

- Adaptability & Mobility: Thrives under pressure in a fast paced, dynamic environment and embraces a “no task is too small” mentality.

- Communication & Influence: Fluency in French and English, with strong cross functional communication and the ability to drive action without relying solely on direct authority, from suppliers to senior executives.

- Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact through statistical modeling, experiment design, Bayesian marketing analysis, and classifier implementation across our search engine, instant answers, AI, and revenue optimization, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

- Defining core growth metrics for our products and building the infrastructure to monitor trends and anomalies

- Measuring the impact of major marketing campaigns for Duck.ai , translating full-funnel data into actionable decisions

- Building monitoring pipelines to detect unexpected shifts in search traffic patterns faster and more reliably

- Expanding evaluation datasets for page context understanding across complex scenarios like multi-tab browsing and content reattachment

- Improving the trigger systems that determine when AI-assisted answers surface in DuckDuckGo Search, balancing quality and our privacy-first approach

title: Responsable Métrologie – Transport de Biologie H/F/X
description:
TopChrono , leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies.

Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous !

Ce que nous vous offrons 

- Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs).

- Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière.

- Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement.

- Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation.

Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact ! 

Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes : 

Rattachement hiérarchique 

• Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au

niveau national.

Mission principale 

Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES 

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température 

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.

• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).

• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.

• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.

Étude et déploiement des matériels 

• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.

• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.

• Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels.

• Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test.

• Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température.

• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.

Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation 

• Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules.

• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.

• Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température.

• Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels).

• Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées.

• Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.

Gestion des fournisseurs 

• Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques.

• Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

• Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires.

• Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

Qualité et amélioration continue 

• Participer aux audits internes et externes.

• Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail.

• Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance.

• Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité.

• Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue.

• Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).

ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES 

Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à : 

• proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ;

• valider les choix techniques des installations ;

• décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ;

• arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ;

• sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation.

• Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.

RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES 

En interne 

• Direction des Opérations

• Responsable Parc Automobile

• Responsable Exploitation

• Service Qualité

• Conducteurs

• Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température).

En externe 

• Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques

• Prestataires de métrologie

• Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.

PROFIL RECHERCHE 

Formation 

• Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent.

Expérience 

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire.

• Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.

Compétences techniques 

• Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision.

• Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid.

• Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15-

140 / COFRAC).

• Analyse de données de température.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique.

Qualités personnelles 

• Sens de l'organisation.

• Rigueur et méthode.

• Esprit d'analyse.

• Capacité de prise de décision.

• Aisance relationnelle.

• Force de proposition.

• Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs.

• Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence.

Objectifs du poste 

• Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules.

• Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique.

• Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température.

• Développer une collaboration efficace entre la métrologie, le parc automobile et l'exploitation afin de sécuriser les opérations de transport.

• Réduire les non-conformités température ayant un impact contractuel ou financier (pénalités, litiges de facturation), suivies via le tableau de bord dédié

title: Technical Customer Support Specialist
description:
About HappyRobot 

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. 

About the Role 
As a Customer Support Engineer , youʼll be on the front lines of our customer
experience. Youʼll work directly with customers to quickly triage issues, debug
problems, and ensure theyʼre getting the most out of HappyRobotʼs AI platform.

This role is a hybrid between technical support and customer engineering: youʼll
diagnose issues, design and test quick solutions, and collaborate closely with both
engineering and product teams to make our platform even stronger.

Youʼll also apply prompt engineering skills to help customers fine-tune their AI
workers, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and speed across real-world logistics
workflows.

This role is ideal for someone with strong technical fundamentals who wants to
grow into a more senior customer engineering or product-facing position over
time.

Tech Profile 

- Comfortable Full-Stack: Python, React, TypeScript, Node.js. 

- Experience managing APIs and integrations with third-party systems.

- Some exposure to infrastructure and cloud deployments.

- Familiarity with LLM prompting and tuning of voices/transcribers; eager to
experiment and iterate.

- Strong debugging and problem-solving skills — quick at identifying the root
cause of issues.

Must Have 

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English — able to explain
technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

- Strong ability to triage, prioritize, and resolve issues independently under
tight deadlines.

- Curiosity and adaptability: you can learn customer workflows quickly and
propose solutions.

- Self-starter mindset — comfortable working independently, with a bias toward
action.

- Passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

Why join us? 

- Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

- Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

- Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

- Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

- Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles 

Extreme Ownership 

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship 

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

About Fresha 

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.

The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC. 

Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions. 

Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management. 

The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google. 

Role overview 

Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Associate Account Manager to come and join our global business. 

Reporting directly to the Account Manager Team Lead, you will be accountable for building relationships and driving monetisation of the Fresha platform. 

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to work in a fast-paced and changing environment, who likes to work autonomously, enjoys a challenge, and wants to make an impact. 

To foster a collaborative environment that thrives on face-to-face interactions and teamwork, all Fresha employees work from office five days per week in Paris, on the Champs-élysées. 

Commercial Growth 

- Engagement - Accountable for meeting key performance indicators on monetisation and revenue growth by proactively engaging with and educating our Partners on the value of the Fresha platform.

- Sales Cycle - Proactively introduce, educate and convert Partners on to Fresha’s payments solution.

- Market Trends - Optimise listing content and availability competitiveness on the marketplace to maximise conversions.

Relationship Building 

- Partnering - Have a pool of Partner accounts serving as a dedicated advisor for all your Partners assisting them on their journey to product adoption.

- Advisor - Advising Partners on suitable product selection based on their needs and specifications.

- Business Partnering - Ensure a strong Partner Experience through building relationships by attending video meetings with your pool of Partners and effectively communicating the Fresha features and benefits.

- Relationships - Build key internal relationships with our Sales and Onboarding teams to ensure smooth transition and handover of Partners through the Partner journey.

- Collaboration - Collaborate with our Product teams to provide important product feedback to help enhance future releases.

- Persuasion - Use consultative sales techniques to understand customer needs and requirements and have the ability to upsell and cross-sell the Fresha Platform.

- This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver. 

What we are looking for 

- Experience - 1-2 Years experience in effectively delivering commercial outcomes from a previous Account Management role

- Closing Skills – Demonstrated ability to effectively close deals, negotiate, and convert opportunities

- Adaptability - Shown to be commercially motivated with an ability to adapt and achieve targets

- Analytics - Proven experience in using and analysing data and reporting effectively to improve commercial outcomes

- Curiosity - Naturally proactive and inquisitive, with a desire to consistently learn and improve

- Tele-prospecting - Previous experience in an outbound call environment or a related sales position preferred

- Communication - Excellent and proven written, verbal and presentation skills

- Innovative - Creative thinking and problem-solving mindset

- Relationship Building - You are a true hunter and relationship builder

- Team Player - Happy to roll sleeves up and assist the team when required

- Initiative - Ability to self-starter with a proactive approach

Added Bonus 

- Bi-lingual - Fluency in English and another language

- Beauty & Wellness - Experience within the beauty and wellness industry

- At Fresha, we value passion and potential as much as specific skills. If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role.

Interview Process 

- Screen Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30 mins)

- Skills & Experience - In-Person interview with Team Leads (30 mins)

- Presentation - In-Person interview with General Manager.

We aim to complete the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 2 weeks . 

- Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe

Inclusive workforce 

At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable. 

We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment. 

We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying. 

If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the interview process and/or once you join, please let us know so that we can support you.
