description:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog , LinkedIn , X , and YouTube .

Why join Dataiku? 

Dataiku’s on-premise, cloud, or SaaS-deployed platform connects many data science technologies, and our technology stack reflects our commitment to quality and innovation. We integrate the best of data and AI tech, selecting tools that truly enhance our product. From the latest LLMs to our dedication to open source communities, you'll work with a dynamic range of technologies and contribute to the collective knowledge of global tech innovators. Here are some useful links so you preview what we do at Dataiku: Dataiku's Key Capabilities ; Dataiku's Github , you can also take a look at the Gallery , a public instance showcasing some example projects (note editing is very limited and will be regularly reset). 

Our product is called Dataiku DSS which stands for Dataiku Data Science Studio. If you’d like to know more about it, you can watch the demo here or try the free version here .

How you’ll make an impact 

At DKU, we have multiple engineering teams focusing on various aspects of the software, including AI/ML, MLOps, Data Preparation, Data Visualization, and Cloud Platform. Each team offers internship opportunities where you'll work on specific features with direct impact on the final product. During the interview process, you'll receive detailed information about the available features and their contribution to the overall project.

As an intern, you will be working with more senior software engineers every day on a potential future feature of our product. With guidance and support, you will be able to code, debug, optimize, and document your work while learning how to deliver qualitative work.

The stack may differ from one internship to another, but the global stack of Dataiku is Python/Java for the backend and Angular/Vue/React for the frontend.

Here are some examples of previous projects our interns worked on:

Unsupervised models: 

- Improve the tooling available for data scientists to train unsupervised (clustering) models in Dataiku

- If time allows, extend further to optimize the training and inference of those types of models

Webapp vibe coding: 

- Build an intelligent “vibe coding” assistant that interprets a user’s intent and aesthetic preferences to automatically generate functional web app code

- Prototype and refine techniques that translate natural-language descriptions into usable web components, accelerating web app development for users without deep front-end expertise

Dynamic model management: 

- Improve management of AI models accessible on already-deployed software to unlock new capabilities without upgrading

- Leverage Dataiku’s LLM Mesh and accelerate customer adoption, helping shape Dataiku’s strategy for agentic AI in the enterprise

AI-powered code generation: 

- Develop and integrate more low-setup code completion features into Dataiku's embedded code editors

- As a time-permitting extension, investigate and potentially implement more AI-powered code generation capabilities to further enhance the coding experience

Flow Search: 

- Significantly enhance the search and filtering capabilities for Dataiku's complex data pipelines by introducing advanced operators

- Implement this powerful search feature by defining a formal query grammar, building an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) to parse user input, and developing a user-friendly interface with live autocompletion and intelligent error feedback

Internationalization: 

- Actively contribute to the internationalization of the Dataiku platform by allowing faster translation of new and existing software components into various languages beyond English

- Improve and optimize the entire internationalization workflow by implementing technical solutions such as lazy loading for resources, automating translations with LLMs, and developing tools for automated error detection

Files Processor: 

- Develop a versatile, all-in-one file processing tool within Dataiku to perform a wide range of transformations and filtering on unstructured data, such as resizing images, converting documents (e.g., DOCX to PDF), and more

- Streamline data preparation workflows by embedding these file manipulation capabilities directly into Dataiku pipelines, improving user efficiency and reducing the need for external tools

Geo-Grouping: 

- Develop and implement a new geospatial transformation tool within the Dataiku platform to compute the convex hull of sets of geometric shapes (points and polygons)

- Enhance Dataiku's capabilities by enabling customers to geo-group their data, unlocking advanced spatial analytics for use cases in fields like retail and logistics

Cloud Engineering: 

- Contribute to the launchpad SaaS portal of Dataiku, building full-stack features and leveraging Kubernetes to deliver scalable, secure instance management for companies

- Improve platform reliability and developer confidence by implementing safe rollouts (feature flags), deep observability (tracing, metrics, dashboards), and broader automated test coverage

What does the hiring process look like? 

- Initial call with a member of our technical recruiting team (30 min) with a presentation of various internship subjects

- Technical assessment to show your skills (take-home test)

- Discussion with the technical recruiter to select the internship topic (15-30 min) 

- Video call with your future manager (1h)

Benefits and Perks:

- 50% reimbursement on Navigo Transport pass and up to 5 paid leaves

- Free breakfasts, snacks, and drinks in our office every day and access to the office canteen

- Opportunities to work with a unique mix of talents and fast career opportunities

- A great place to learn: you will master the key skills of the tech world

Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

Why this role

You are the technical voice in front of strategic customers, at a moment when hospitality is being rebuilt around AI. We are launching our own AI agent platform, and we need architects who can show operators what comes next.

- High trust. You own the technical answer in front of strategic customers and deals.

- High visibility. Your work shows up in deals, key accounts and customer stories, and it reaches Product.

- High freedom. You decide how to solve a problem, which tools to use and what to prototype.

- Fast iteration. We test ideas within days, try new technology early and share what works.

Your mission

Win and grow strategic accounts with technical credibility, and turn what you learn in the field into input for the product. You look at a customer's current architecture and show how an Apaleo-centred setup delivers their goals. You also help them put AI agents to work, deciding what should be an agent, what it costs and how to set it up. Sales and Account Management own the relationship and the commercial terms. You own the technical answer.

What you will do

- Technical discovery and solution scoping. Lead discovery where a standard demo is not enough. Write clear scopes covering what Apaleo delivers natively, what needs a short-term solution and what is out of scope.

- Proofs of concept. Build fast, working proofs of concept (quick demos that show technical fit). Agree scope in writing first, and build in a safe test environment, never with live guest data.

- Agents and automations. Design and build agents and automations for customer use cases, using n8n or Make today and Apaleo's own AI agent platform as it launches. Write code where agents need deterministic steps.

- Hands-on delivery and short-term solutions. Work alongside the customer, building only where it unblocks a named deal, removes an adoption risk or fills a product gap. Agree an exit plan (an end date, a replacement and a named owner) before you start.

- Post-sale health checks and expansions. Diagnose gaps against the go-live specification, run proactive checks (for example 90 days after go-live) and scope integrations for expanding customers.

- Reusable assets. Turn every engagement into a reference architecture, pattern or template that the next twenty customers can use.

- Thought leadership. Join prospect and customer conversations on how AI will change hospitality over the next two to three years.

- Product feedback. Test new technology on real customer problems. Share prototypes and field evidence with Product, ending every experiment with a clear decision: adopt, hand over or drop.

How you work

- You decide the approach, the stack and the order of work.

- You protect three guardrails: written scope before a proof of concept, an exit plan before a custom build and no commercial promises.

- You go from idea to prototype in days and show it early.

- You think in systems and build for reuse, not one-off projects.

- You share findings openly with Sales, Account Management and Product.

Who you work with

Sales/BD and Account Management (they call you in at defined deal triggers), Customer Success, Product, Security, Partnerships, RevOps and Senior Leadership. 

What you bring

Must have 

- Multiple years in solution architecture, solution engineering or technical consulting in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex software such as ERP or enterprise platforms

- Strong API skills: REST, authentication, webhooks and events, and data-flow design

- Hands-on workflow automation (n8n preferred) and practical experience building with LLM agents

- A systems thinker with real AI curiosity, who uses AI tools day to day

- Stakeholder management experience and credibility with executives and IT teams

- Self-direction, an ownership mindset and the discipline to say no to scope that does not advance a deal

- Curiosity that ends in working prototypes, not just opinions

- Clear, structured documentation habits

- Fluent English and French skills

- Willingness to travel, including regularly to France and the UK

Strong plus 

- Hospitality or travel experience, including hotel operations and PMS concepts (reservations, folios, rate plans, night audit)

- Experience with another cloud PMS, channel manager or payments integrations

- Enterprise architecture experience on large, multi-site projects

- Applied AI or ML background, or experience with MCP and agent platforms

- SQL and BI fundamentals

How we measure success

- Architecture engagements and blueprints delivered each quarter

- Customer satisfaction with your contribution

- Adoption of recommended apps, integrations and agents

- Share of engagements served by an existing reusable pattern

- Revenue impact e.g. deal unblocked, AI adoption, or churn averted

Your first 90 days

- Days 1 to 30: Learn the platform and ways of working, shadow discovery and proof of concept work, and take over open customer projects.

- Days 31 to 60: Lead technical discovery on live deals and run your first health check with Account Management.

- Days 61 to 90: Deliver a proof of concept or short-term solution end to end with an exit plan, and share your first experiment with Product.

What We Offer 

Culture & Growth 

- A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.

- Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You’ll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.

- Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration.

- Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you’ll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.

- Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution.

Perks & Lifestyle 

- Flexible & Remote Work Options: We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business.

- Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events.

- Paid Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired.

- Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role it’s about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions, and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey.

We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

description:
About Mistral 

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

Evaluation is how we decide which models, checkpoints and recipes ship. As a Research Engineer on the Eval Platform team, you will build the infrastructure every science team relies on to measure model quality, and make it reliable, reproducible and fast.

You don't need to have designed benchmarks before. You do need to care about what a score means, and about when a difference between two runs is real.

What you will do

- Build systems that keep eval results reproducible and comparable over time, as models, benchmarks and code evolve.

- Run evaluations at scale across our GPU clusters, from model serving to scoring.

- Make eval results easy to access, explore and trust, through APIs and dashboards that researchers use every day.

- Catch broken or noisy evals before they mislead research decisions.

- Support evaluation of agentic, multi-turn and tool-using models.

- Work closely with researchers to turn new evaluation needs into robust, shared tooling.

What we're looking for

- Master's or PhD in Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

- 4+ years building production-grade software, ideally large-scale ML codebases or distributed systems.

- Excellent Python and strong software-design instincts: testing, code review, CI/CD.

- Experience running workloads on GPU clusters (Slurm, Kubernetes, Ray or similar).

- Familiarity with LLM inference and evaluation.

- A product mindset: researchers are your users.

- Self-starter, low-ego, collaborative.

Nice to have

- Experience building or maintaining evaluation harnesses or benchmarks.

- Hands-on experience with inference engines such as vLLM or SGLang.

- Experience with agentic or RL environments.

- Statistics for experimentation: variance estimation, significance testing.

description:
About Nabla 

We are a team of entrepreneurs, clinicians and engineers committed to bringing back joy to the practice of medicine.

Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day.

We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows.

Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere.

This is a great time to join us!

Early Careers: Software Engineering & Machine Learning 

We’re looking for early-career engineers who want to learn fast, work with experienced mentors, and make a real impact from day one. You’ll join a collaborative, mission-driven team where technical curiosity and humility matter as much as skill.

Location: Paris (Hybrid)

Start Date: 2027 (or as early as possible)

Commitment: Internship-to-hire

What we Offer 

- Real Impact from Day One: You won’t be stuck with small tasks: you’ll contribute to real features and products.

- Learning Everywhere: We believe in mentorship, pair programming, and leveling up together.

- Lean, Ambitious Team: Be part of a fast-moving, deeply technical culture where your contributions matter.

- Healthcare Mission: Help doctors, nurses, and care teams spend more time with Patients

- Career Launchpad: Many interns convert to full-time, and early engineers grow quickly.

We work across multiple domains: 

- Apps: Web app, frontend logic, UI/UX

- Platform: Backend services, infrastructure, APIs

- Core (ML): Algorithms, models, data systems

Your DNA 

- Currently pursuing or recently graduated in Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Math, or a related field .

- Comfortable coding in at least one: Java, Kotlin, Python, or TypeScript .

- Passionate about AI, data, or building meaningful product features.

- Curious, collaborative, and excited to learn.

- Humble and resilient — you ask questions, take feedback, and grow.

Nice-to-Haves (but not required) 

- Internship or personal projects in AI, full-stack, or backend systems.

- Experience with React, GraphQL, or cloud infrastructure.

- Knowledge of CI/CD, Docker, or automated testing.

You’ll see us on campus at: 

- Télécom Paris

- Forum Trium

- ENSIMAG

- CentraleSupélec

- École Polytechnique

- EPFL

- Forum Organisation

Meet us there and tell us what excites you. 

Life at Nabla 

When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed.

We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes.

We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts!

If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application!

Our Values at Nabla 

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel 

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble 

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift 

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity 

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion 

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment scam which is now using Nabla to collect personal information or financial scams. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure whomever is contacting you truly represents Nabla and is utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity from people who could be pretending to be recruiters or senior professionals at Nabla. You can find more information following this link .

Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

title: Head of Formal Verification (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission You own the direction of our formal verification business. Our managers keep delivery predictable. You decide what the organisation becomes.

You report to the CEO and are a member of the executive leadership team. You carry the FV consulting business as a whole — where it goes, how it performs, who leads it — and you answer for it. You will not solve verification problems, and you will rarely run a project or an account yourself. Concretely, you own:

- Direction . The roadmap for FV consulting. Which capabilities, markets and problem domains we pursue, and what we decline.
- Customers. You are the face of LUBIS EDA to our key accounts and at executive level. You open the doors your managers cannot, and you carry the conversations that decide a long-term relationship.
- Organisation . Structure, standards, playbooks, talent pipelines, and the career framework in practice. You keep improving how we work, and you decide when a new technology — AI among them — changes the way we deliver.
- Leaders . Our Verification Managers report to you. You hire them, develop them, and grow the bench behind them. This is the main measure of the role.
- Quality . Holding the quality bar under commercial pressure. Our entire positioning depends on it.
- Product interface . What our engineers learn on customer projects is the best input our software roadmap gets.

Your profile You have developed leaders, not "only" engineers. You have set direction where there was no precedent, made the calls, and carried an organisation with you. You build systems that outlast your attention. 

You need credibility in formal verification. Not to overrule your senior engineers. You need it to make the calls only you can make: is a capability gap real, is a quality standard achievable at the price we quote, does a bet on a new formal domain hold. 

YOUR EXPERIENCE - 12+ years in semiconductor verification, EDA or adjacent engineering services. 
- 5+ years in leadership, including managers reporting to you. 
- Fluent in formal methods and their trade-offs. Credible with a customer’s engineering leadership and on a conference stage. 
- You know how technical services are priced and defended on quality rather than volume. 
- Nice-to-have: you have scaled a technical organisation past start-up stage, where the systems had to be built. 

Why us? LUBIS is growing, and we’re looking for a Head of Formal Verification. 

This is one of those roles where you don’t just join an organisation. You help build it. 

Our formal sign-off business is growing. Our customers are getting bigger. So are our ambitions. We’re looking for someone who wants real ownership of what comes next: how we develop our people, how we deliver outstanding projects, how we work with our customers, and what world-class technical consulting at LUBIS should look like. 

You’ll work directly with our leadership team. You’ll have the freedom to shape structures and standards. You’ll build an organisation around some of the strongest formal verification expertise in the market. 

We’re not looking for someone to maintain what already exists. We’re looking for someone who gets excited about making it better, bigger and more professional. 

If you want a leadership role with real influence, and the chance to build something you’ll be proud of, come build it with us.

title: Production Engineer
description:
As a Production Engineer, you will play a key role within our Test Engineering team, programming test software and documenting test procedures to scale production of our next-generation drone platforms. In this position, you will take ownership of verification and production test equipment, from defining test concepts to designing automated test solutions, jigs and needle-bed adapters that help us improve yield and reliability. You’ll collaborate closely with our software and electronics engineers and OEM partners to enhance test coverage and reduce testing time, driving efficiency across our manufacturing process.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, agile environment, offering the opportunity to design creative, practical test solutions from concept through to mass production. This involves balancing the transition from our existing test setups to more scalable and complete solutions in a pragmatic and iterative way for a number of different projects.

Beyond test engineering, you’ll apply your software expertise across the broader hardware and software team by supporting the engineering validation efforts of new products. You will also visit OEMs to support new product integrations and support small scale engineering runs in person.

Responsibilities and Duties 

- Research, design and build test solutions, including auto generated, 3D printed test equipment and CNC milled custom test jigs, and needle-bed adapters to enable low-volume prototyping and mid- to high-volume PCB production.

- Plan and execute product verification, covering test case definition, execution, analysis, and comprehensive documentation, also for repair guidance.

- Write Python code and STM32 firmware to test our embedded products from the inside (selftest) and outside (via test fixture).

- Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams by offering technical guidance and hands-on support for testing and validation of advanced avionics PCBs and modular systems.

- Specify and document additional manufacturer tests (like flying probe) to allow for a layered, holistic approach to test coverage.

- Write Repair Guides that document the error cases and the affected components.

- Guide manufacturers with new product integrations usually in person in the factory.

- Manage tracking systems across multiple locations to inspect the product workflow.

- Support internal CI systems with real hardware to validate test procedures before upgrading test fixtures at OEMs.

Qualifications and Skills 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical field.

- Proficiency in modern Python and C/C++ also applied to embedded systems.

- 5+ years of experience in programming software that runs on real hardware and testing it on real hardware.

- CAD experience (e.g., Onshape) and soldering skills are required.

- Practical experience in Linux, microcontroller programming, 3D printing, and related prototyping tools.

- Pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.

- Good verbal and written English communication skills.

Benefits 

- Flexible working hours

- Stock Options

- Generous holiday allowance

- Company pension plan 

- Car parking 

- Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

- Mental health and wellbeing support

- Learning and development opportunities

About Auterion 

We are building the leading software and electronics platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

description:

title: Head of Hardware
description:
Accelerating embodied AGI. 

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors.

You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them.

This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat. We are looking for someone who has carried a product from a blank page to customers with real skin in the game, wants to build both the thing and the team that builds it, and would rather design than review. If that sounds like you, you will want to do it again at the earliest stage.

What You Will Do

- Own the hardware roadmap for Shift and Atlas data capture: wearables, sensor rigs, camera systems, and prototype robots. What we build, in what order, and why.

- Set the system architecture across electrical, firmware, and mechanical: sensors, compute, power, wireless, and enclosures. Make the trade-offs, and make them stick when disciplines disagree.

- Stay on the bench: schematics, layout reviews, board bring-up, and a scope in your hands when the team is stuck. On the days it matters, you are the best electrical engineer in the room.

- Lead and grow the team: hire, set the bar, run design reviews, and give engineers ownership of whole subsystems rather than tickets.

- Guarantee data quality end to end: EMG and EEG front ends, camera pipelines, IMUs, and synchronization across many devices, so that what reaches the ML team is clean, time-aligned, and trustworthy.

- Take designs from prototype to small-batch production: DFM, component and EMS vendors, test fixtures, certification, and field reliability.

- Work shoulder to shoulder with ML and deployment. Your hardware decides what the training data looks like, and you will be on the floor where it is captured.

- Run contractors and partners without losing ownership of the result.

Requirements

- You have taken at least one product from zero to shipped, with significant ownership of the outcome: as a co-founder, CTO, first hardware hire, or the lead who owned the whole device. Not one subsystem, not one phase. Ideally a wearable, at a tier-one hardware company known for shipping at scale.

- Electrical engineering is your home discipline. You have designed boards that shipped, across mixed-signal, power, wireless, and high-speed digital, and you can still do it today.

- You think in systems. You understand how an electrode choice, an enclosure tolerance, and an ADC sample rate interact, and you can hold the mechanical and firmware conversations as a peer, not a customer.

- You have led engineers: hired them, grown them, and kept a team shipping through 0-to-1 ambiguity. Typically 6+ years in hardware, but we care more about what you shipped than how long it took.

- A strong understanding of how hardware decisions affect data quality. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you design accordingly.

- Experience taking hardware to small-batch production: DFM, vendor and EMS management, test, and certification.

- Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

- High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. A 0-to-1 hardware program takes the hours it takes, in person and at pace, and you have chosen that before.

- Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

Nice to Have

- Wearables, smartwatches, drones, robotics, AR/VR, or defense wearables on your résumé.

- Camera systems: sensor selection, MIPI and ISP pipelines, and multi-camera synchronization.

- Low-power and battery design, BLE or Wi-Fi, and antenna integration in small enclosures.

- Enough mechanical fluency (CAD, tolerances, and materials) to challenge the mechanical team’s choices and be right some of the time.

- Prior founder or founding-engineer experience, including the parts that went wrong.

- Open-source hardware or firmware contributions.

Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

- Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

- Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

- Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

- Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if: 

- You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

- You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

- You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if: 

- You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

- You would forward output you cannot explain.

- "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

- Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

- Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

- Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

- Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

- Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

- Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

- Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

- A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

- Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on   LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

About the role 

WPP Enterprise Solutions in Amsterdam is the central hub for SEO and GEO expertise across the WPP network. From our team, we work with major national and international organisations on complex challenges across search, websites, digital platforms and AI-driven discovery.

Our team currently consists of ten SEO and GEO specialists and is growing rapidly. We are therefore looking for a Senior Technical SEO Specialist to strengthen our technical capabilities.

This is explicitly not a traditional SEO role with some technical SEO added on top. We are looking for someone who approaches SEO from a technical perspective. Someone who understands how websites, platforms, JavaScript frameworks, crawlers, rendering, APIs and search engines interact, and who can independently investigate and solve complex technical problems.

You are comfortable working with SEO specialists, developers, solution architects, product teams and other technical stakeholders. You are able to go deep into the technology when needed, while also translating complex findings into clear priorities, recommendations and implementations for enterprise clients.

What you will do 

As a Senior Technical SEO Specialist, you will be responsible for the technical quality and scalability of our SEO solutions. You will work on complex websites and digital ecosystems where standard SEO checklists are simply not enough.

Your responsibilities will include: 

- Conducting advanced technical SEO audits for large and complex websites, platforms and international domain structures.

- Analysing crawling, indexing and rendering to identify the root causes of technical SEO and indexation issues.

- Working with modern JavaScript frameworks and rendering architectures, including SSR, CSR, SSG and hybrid rendering.

- Analysing HTML, JavaScript, HTTP requests, response headers, status codes, redirects, canonicalisation and robots directives.

- Investigating and optimising crawl architecture, internal linking and information architecture for websites with hundreds of thousands or millions of URLs.

- Advising on complex technical challenges involving migrations, replatforming, URL structures, faceted navigation, pagination, internationalisation and hreflang.

- Performing log file analysis to understand how Googlebot and other crawlers interact with websites and to improve crawl efficiency.

- Developing scripts, tooling and automation that make recurring analyses faster, more reliable and more scalable.

- Reviewing technical solutions, specifications and implementations from an SEO perspective before they go live.

- Working closely with developers and engineering teams to translate SEO recommendations into clear technical requirements and tickets.

The technical expertise we are looking for 

For this role, we are looking for someone whose technical capabilities go well beyond using standard SEO tools.

You have a strong understanding of: 

- HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and can independently analyse source code and identify technical issues.

- HTTP and web architecture, including requests and responses, status codes, caching, redirects, headers and CDN behaviour.

- JavaScript SEO and the implications of client-side and server-side rendering for crawling, rendering and indexing.

- Technical concepts such as SSR, CSR, SSG, hydration and dynamic rendering.

- Crawling and indexing, and how search engines technically process websites.

- txt, XML sitemaps, canonical tags, meta robots, X-Robots-Tag and other crawling and indexing directives.

- Structured data and Schema.org.

- Core Web Vitals and web performance.

- International websites, hreflang and complex multi-market architectures.

- Website and platform migrations.

- Crawl budget and scalable website architectures.

You do not need to be a software engineer in every area. However, we do expect you to be comfortable reading code, manipulating data, working with APIs and building scripts or technical solutions when needed.

What seniority means to us

Being senior means more than being able to independently deliver a technical SEO audit.

We expect you to be able to break down complex technical problems where there is no obvious answer. You combine experience, data and technical knowledge to define your own investigative approach and develop solutions that can realistically scale within enterprise organisations.

You will also:

- Proactively improve the way we work, using tooling and AI to increase efficiency, quality and impact.

- Make significant improvements to our SEO guidelines, workflows and processes.

- Develop innovative solutions to complex SEO challenges, including algorithm changes, large-scale site architecture, crawling and automation.

- Build frameworks, templates, scripts and automations that can be adopted across multiple clients and projects.

- Independently develop new approaches for challenges where no standard solution exists.

- Think beyond what needs to change and consider how solutions can be technically and organisationally implemented at scale.

- Help other SEO specialists grow their technical capabilities.

Act as a senior technical sparring partner for our clients.

What you'll need: 

- 10+ years of experience in Technical SEO, with a strong track record of solving complex technical SEO challenges for large-scale, international and/or enterprise websites.

- Currently based in the Netherlands and able to work from our WPP office in Amsterdam.

- Deep technical knowledge of how modern websites are built, crawled, rendered and indexed, including strong expertise in HTML, JavaScript, HTTP, web architecture and rendering technologies.

- Strong experience working with l arge and complex website architectures, including crawling and indexation, faceted navigation, internationalisation, migrations, internal linking and crawl budget optimisation.

- Experience with Python and/or JavaScript for scripting and automation is highly desirable, as is experience with SQL, BigQuery or comparable data environments.

- A proven ability to turn complex technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for developers, product teams, architects and senior stakeholders.

- Experience developing scalable frameworks, tooling, templates or automations that can be applied across multiple clients or projects.

- An eager and proactive mindset, with a strong interest in exploring how AI, automation, emerging search technologies and GEO can improve both our work and our clients' performance.

- Fluent in English. Dutch is highly desirable.

What we offer: 

We offer a competitive salary, a vibrant and collaborative culture and ample opportunities for professional growth. You'll be part of a global network of talent, working on projects that truly make an impact. 

Our compensation: 

- A gross annual salary range of 80,000€ - 95,000€, based on experience level.

- Hybrid working flexibility.

- Access to learning platforms .

- Wellbeing initiatives including mental health support programs and wellness activities. 

- Employee discounts and access to WPP/VML global benefits ecosystem. 

- Participation in team events, agency gatherings and cross-discipline workshops. 

- At WPP ES, we believe in investing in people who build long-term value for our clients and their customers. Your growth is part of our growth. 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. title: Research Staff, Voice AI Foundations - Remote
description:
Company Overview 

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm 

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

The Opportunity

Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.

The Role

As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems:

- Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio.

- Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech.

- Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”.

- Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio. Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment and 2) produce empathic, human-like responses that achieve conversational or task-oriented objectives. 

- Design model architectures, training schemes, and inference algorithms that are adapted for hardware at the bare metal enabling cost efficient training on billion-hour datasets and powering real-time inference for hundreds of millions of concurrent conversations.

The Challenge

We are seeking researchers who:

- See "unsolved" problems as opportunities to pioneer entirely new approaches

- Can identify the one critical experiment that will validate or kill an idea in days, not months

- Have the vision to scale successful proofs-of-concept 100x

- Are obsessed with using AI to automate and amplify your own impact

If you find yourself energized rather than daunted by these expectations—if you're already thinking about five ideas to try while reading this—you might be the researcher we need. This role demands obsession with the problems, creativity in approach, and relentless drive toward elegant, scalable solutions. The technical challenges are immense, but the potential impact is transformative.

It's Important to Us That You Have

- Strong mathematical foundation in statistical learning theory, particularly in areas relevant to self-supervised and multimodal learning

- Deep expertise in foundation model architectures, with an understanding of how to scale training across multiple modalities

- Proven ability to bridge theory and practice—someone who can both derive novel mathematical formulations and implement them efficiently

- Demonstrated ability to build data pipelines that can process and curate massive datasets while maintaining quality and diversity

- Track record of designing controlled experiments that isolate the impact of architectural innovations and validate theoretical insights

- Experience optimizing models for real-world deployment, including knowledge of hardware constraints and efficiency techniques

- History of open-source contributions or research publications that have advanced the state of the art in speech/language AI

Ideal Researcher Profile

An ideal researcher, as evidenced by the recurring themes across these foundational papers, excels in five key areas: (1) Statistical & Mathematical Foundations, (2) Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation, (3) Data-Driven & Scalable Systems, (4) Hardware & Systems Understanding, and (5) Rigorous Experimental Design. Below is a synthesis of how each paper highlights these qualities, with references illustrating why they matter for building robust, impactful deep learning models.

1. Statistical & Mathematical Foundations 

Mastery of Core Concepts 

Many papers, like Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models and Neural Discrete Representation Learning (VQ-VAE), reflect the importance of power-law analyses, derivation of novel losses, or adaptation of fundamental equations (e.g., in VQ-VAE's commitment loss or rectified flows in Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers). Such mathematical grounding clarifies why models converge or suffer collapse.

Combining Existing Theories in Novel Ways 

Papers such as Moshi (combining text modeling, audio codecs, and hierarchical generative modeling) and Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ's adaptation of classic scalar quantization to replace vector-quantized representations) show how reusing but reimagining known techniques can yield breakthroughs. Many references (e.g., the structured state-space duality in Transformers are SSMs) underscore how unifying previously separate research lines can reveal powerful algorithmic or theoretical insights.

Logical Reasoning and Assumption Testing 

Across all papers—particularly in the problem statements of Whisper or Rectified Flow Transformers—the authors present assumptions (e.g., "scaling data leads to zero-shot robustness" or "straight-line noise injection improves sample efficiency") and systematically verify them with thorough empirical results. An ideal researcher similarly grounds new ideas in well-formed, testable hypotheses.

2. Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation 

Creative Solutions to Known Bottlenecks 

Each paper puts forth a unique algorithmic contribution—Rectified Flow Transformers redefines standard diffusion paths, FSQ proposes simpler scalar quantizations contrasted with VQ, phi-3 mini relies on curated data and blocksparse attention, and Mamba-2 merges SSM speed with attention concepts.

Turning Theory into Practice 

Whether it's the direct preference optimization (DPO) for alignment in phi-3 or the residual vector quantization in SoundStream, these works show that bridging design insights with implementable prototypes is essential.

Clear Impact Through Prototypes & Open-Source 

Many references (Whisper, neural discrete representation learning, Mamba-2) highlight releasing code or pretrained models, enabling the broader community to replicate and build upon new methods. This premise of collaboration fosters faster progress.

3. Data-Driven & Scalable Systems 

Emphasis on Large-Scale Data and Efficient Pipelines 

Papers such as Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (Whisper) and BASE TTS demonstrate that collecting and processing hundreds of thousands of hours of real-world audio can unlock new capabilities in zero-shot or low-resource domains. Meanwhile, phi-3 Technical Report shows that filtering and curating data at scale (e.g., "data optimal regime") can yield high performance even in smaller models.

Strategic Use of Data for Staged Training 

A recurring strategy is to vary sources of data or the order of tasks. Whisper trains on multilingual tasks, BASE TTS uses subsets/stages for pretraining on speech tokens, and phi-3 deploys multiple training phases (web data, then synthetic data). This systematic approach to data underscores how an ideal researcher designs training curricula and data filtering protocols for maximum performance.

4. Hardware & Systems Understanding 

Efficient Implementations at Scale 

Many works illustrate how researchers tune architectures for modern accelerators: the In-Datacenter TPU paper exemplifies domain-specific hardware design for dense matrix multiplications, while phi-3 leverages blocksparse attention and custom Triton kernels to run advanced LLMs on resource-limited devices.

Real-Time & On-Device Constraints 

SoundStream shows how to compress audio in real time on a smartphone CPU, demonstrating that knowledge of hardware constraints (latency, limited memory) drives design choices. Similarly, Moshi's low-latency streaming TTS and phi-3-mini's phone-based inference highlight that an ideal researcher must adapt algorithms to resource limits while maintaining robustness.

Architectural & Optimization Details 

Papers like Mamba-2 in Transformers are SSMs and the In-Datacenter TPU work show how exploiting specialized matrix decomposition, custom memory hierarchies, or quantization approaches can lead to breakthroughs in speed or energy efficiency.

5. Rigorous Experimental Design 

Controlled Comparisons & Ablations 

Nearly all papers—Whisper, FSQ, Mamba-2, BASE TTS—use systematic ablations to isolate the impact of individual components (e.g., ablation on vector-quantization vs. scalar quantization in FSQ, or size of codebooks in VQ-VAEs). This approach reveals which design decisions truly matter.

Multifold Evaluation Metrics 

From MUSHRA listening tests (SoundStream, BASE TTS) to FID in image synthesis (Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers, FSQ) to perplexity or zero-shot generalization in language (phi-3, Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models), the works demonstrate the value of comprehensive, carefully chosen metrics.

title: Maintenance Lead

description:
Je brengt rust, geeft richting en weet hoe je een team in beweging krijgt. Op onze locatie in Doetinchem geef je leiding aan de teams Noten Verpakken en Noten Processing: samen zo’n 60 collega’s die dagelijks werken aan de lekkerste (borrel)noten. Een dynamische productieomgeving waarin prestaties, continu verbeteren en werkplezier hand in hand gaan. 

In Doetinchem produceren we daarnaast meer dan 75 soorten pindakaas. Grote kans dus dat je iets van ons in huis hebt. Onze dagelijkse uitdaging is om supermarkten steeds van de juiste voorraden te voorzien. Dat vraagt om een productieorganisatie die elke dag scherp is, vooruitkijkt en samen blijft verbeteren. De operatie bestaat uit twee fabrieken en vier lijnstructuren. Als Senior Line Lead ben je verantwoordelijk voor Noten Verpakken en Noten Processing. Je werkt nauw samen met de Line Leads van beide teams en zorgt samen met hen voor een optimale output van de notenfabriek. Onze operatie draait in 3 ploegen, zelf werk je in dagdienst. 

Onze ambitie is helder: een factory of the future met 100% betrokkenheid van alle collega’s en nul verliezen. Een omgeving waarin iedereen verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor zijn of haar deel van het proces. Met IWS (Integrated Work System) als onze verbetermethodiek werken we stap voor stap aan die ambitie. 

Wat ga je doen? 

Je geeft leiding in een productieomgeving waar veel tegelijk gebeurt. Juist daar zorg jij voor overzicht, duidelijke prioriteiten en een werksfeer waarin collega’s zich gezien en gehoord voelen. Je neemt de leiding wanneer dat nodig is, maar geeft je teams vooral de ruimte om zelf verantwoordelijkheid te pakken, beslissingen te nemen en initiatief te tonen. 

Samen met de lijnteams werk je continu aan betere prestaties. Je begeleidt de organisatie door de verschillende IWS-fasen en geeft richting tijdens de dagelijkse DDS-overleggen (Daily Direction Setting). Als ambassadeur van IWS help je collega’s begrijpen hoe continu verbeteren onderdeel wordt van het dagelijkse werk. 

Je draagt de verantwoordelijkheid voor de resultaten van jouw productiegebied over de volledige operatie. Je bent daarom veel op de werkvloer te vinden. Daar ondersteun en ontwikkel je collega’s, zie je waar processen beter kunnen en zorg je dat verbeteringen daadwerkelijk worden doorgevoerd. Je analyseert onder andere verbruik, doorlooptijden, afwijkingen en andere procesvariabelen en gebruikt systemen als ERP, FMES en Ultimo om prestaties inzichtelijk te maken. Daarnaast neem je deel aan projecten en werk je intensief samen met onder andere Technische Dienst, Quality Control en Technologie aan procesanalyses en verbeteringen. 

Je rapporteert aan de Plant Manager. 

Wat bieden we jou? 

Je krijgt een stevige leidinggevende rol binnen een productieomgeving waarin volop wordt geïnvesteerd in mensen, processen en technologie. Daarbij werk je samen met gedreven collega’s die er iedere dag iets beter van willen maken. Je krijgt: 

- Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €5.640 - €8.450 op basis van 40 uur, passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring; 

- Een jaarcontract voor 36-40 uur per week, met de intentie om dit daarna om te zetten naar een contract voor onbepaalde tijd; 

- 25 vakantiedagen en 3 ADV-dagen per jaar (op fulltime basis); 

- Een pensioenregeling waarbij wij twee derde van de premie betalen; 

- Een personeelswinkel met aantrekkelijke kortingen; 

- Vier keer per jaar een goedgevuld snackpakket; 

- Ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen een internationale productieorganisatie. 

Jouw ingrediënten 

Je hebt ervaring in een leidinggevende functie binnen een productieomgeving, bij voorkeur in food, en beschikt over een afgeronde hbo-opleiding. Je begrijpt hoe productie- en logistieke processen werken en hebt kennis van hygiëne-, kwaliteits- en health & safety-systemen en voorschriften. Ervaring met continu verbeteren is belangrijk; kennis van IWS of vergelijkbare verbetermethodieken is mooi meegenomen. Je bent analytisch, houdt overzicht wanneer de druk toeneemt en weet mensen mee te nemen in verandering. Daarbij combineer je duidelijk leiderschap met aandacht voor de ontwikkeling van je team. Je beheerst Nederlands en Engels goed. 

Wie zijn wij? 

Intersnack is een van de toonaangevende snackproducenten van Europa. We produceren bekende merken en private label-producten die je terugvindt in vrijwel iedere supermarkt. Bij ons staat ondernemend handelen centraal. Je krijgt ruimte om initiatief te nemen, verbeteringen door te voeren en verantwoordelijkheid te pakken. Tegelijkertijd doen we het samen. De sfeer is nuchter en professioneel, de lijnen zijn kort en collega’s helpen elkaar wanneer dat nodig is. Samen groeien en verantwoord denken zijn belangrijke onderdelen van onze cultuur. We combineren de kennis en ervaring van onze teams met individueel eigenaarschap en blijven investeren in innovatie, veiligheid, duurzaamheid en efficiëntere productie. 

Zie jij jezelf leidinggeven aan twee belangrijke teams binnen onze notenfabriek en samen met hen bouwen aan de productieomgeving van de toekomst? Solliciteer dan op de functie van Senior Line Lead.

Samen met ons ga je ervoor zorgen dat onze klanten over de beste ICT-oplossingen beschikken. En ja, gezelligheid hoort daar ook bij: van een BBQ tot een paasbrunch of kerstborrel. Nieuwsgierig? Check de video!

Jouw stage in het kort: 

Na een inwerkperiode ga je actief en zelfstandig meehelpen binnen het bedrijf. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid. Als stagiair ga je ons team echt ondersteunen bij de dagelijkse werkzaamheden. Je gaat tickets afhandelen en de telefoon aannemen. Ook ga je hardware/software installeren, intern of voor klanten. Soms mag je mee op om bij een klanten te werken op locatie. Een ervaren collega gaat je hierbij begeleiden. Natuurlijk zorgen we er ook voor dat je genoeg tijd en hulp hebt om je schoolopdrachten te maken.

Herken jij jezelf hierin? 

Je bent bezig met een opleiding in de ICT. Je hebt de motivatie om van je stage een succes te maken. Daarnaast toon je initiatief en ben je gemotiveerd om actief mee te helpen op de afdeling.

Goed om te weten! 
Presteren en lol maken gaan hand in hand. We zijn een hecht team en er is altijd een collega om je verder te helpen. We hebben ook diverse trainingen beschikbaar om je kennis te verbreden. 

Daarnaast:

- Leuke stageplek voor 32-40 uur per week

- Fijne betrokken werksfeer en informele organisatie

- Laptop, headset, muis en toetsenbord worden geregeld

- Goede begeleiding door ervaren collega’s

- Stagevergoeding

- Onze wel bekende hoodie

- Nog iets anders nodig? Laat het ons weten!

Hallo nieuwe stagiair? 

Interesse? Solliciteer direct!

Wil je meer weten over deze stage? Bel of app Nadia op telefoonnummer 06-45832424.

Sollicitatieproces 

Zodra we je sollicitatie ontvangen, nemen we deze direct in behandeling. We houden van snel schakelen. Daarom laten we je binnen 2 werkdagen weten of je wordt uitgenodigd voor een kennismakingsgesprek. Is iedereen enthousiast over de kennismaking en past deze stage precies bij jou? Dan word jij onze nieuwe stagiair!

→ Een VOG is onderdeel van onze sollicitatieprocedure. Als je solliciteert ga je akkoord met ons Privacybeleid . 

Locatie 

Karel Doormanweg 5, 3115 JD Schiedam.
